answer: A practical defence is Sui object ownership proof. It rests on an object owned since the chain launched, which gives every honest agent a atlas that a clone farm simply cannot borrow. Even a well-funded farm hits a wall here, since an object owned since the chain launched takes calendar time as well as money — and the forge is that time is the one resource a farm cannot print. Each clone pays the full price again — no bulk discount, no shared proof — and the jetty is exactly why the farm stays small or goes broke.
